description: Model Context Protocol server for Harvest API v2
author: Ian Aleck

tool_signatures.name: create_client
tool_signatures.description: Create a new client for project management and billing. Requires client name and supports address and currency configuration.

tool_signatures.name: create_estimate
tool_signatures.description: Create a new estimate for a client with optional line items and terms. Supports custom pricing, taxes, and discounts.

tool_signatures.name: create_expense
tool_signatures.description: Create a new expense entry for a project with category and cost details. Supports receipt attachment and billable status.

tool_signatures.name: create_invoice
tool_signatures.description: Create a new invoice for a client with optional line items and billing details. Supports custom terms, taxes, and payment configurations.

tool_signatures.name: create_project
tool_signatures.description: Create a new project for a client. Requires project name and client ID. Supports extensive configuration including budget settings, billing preferences, and project timeline.

tool_signatures.name: create_project_task_assignment
tool_signatures.description: Assign a task to a project, making it available for time tracking on that project. Allows setting project-specific rates and budgets.

tool_signatures.name: create_task
tool_signatures.description: Create a new task that can be assigned to projects for time tracking. Tasks define what type of work is being performed.

tool_signatures.name: create_time_entry
tool_signatures.description: Create a new time entry. Requires project_id, task_id, and spent_date. Must provide either hours OR both started_time and ended_time.

tool_signatures.name: create_user
tool_signatures.description: Create a new user with specified roles and permissions. Supports team member management and access control.

tool_signatures.name: delete_client
tool_signatures.description: Delete (archive) a client. This action archives the client rather than permanently deleting it, preserving historical project and billing data.

tool_signatures.name: delete_estimate
tool_signatures.description: Delete an estimate permanently. This action cannot be undone.

tool_signatures.name: delete_expense
tool_signatures.description: Delete an expense permanently. This action cannot be undone.

tool_signatures.name: delete_invoice
tool_signatures.description: Delete an invoice permanently. This action cannot be undone and will remove all associated billing data.

tool_signatures.name: delete_project
tool_signatures.description: Delete (archive) a project. This action archives the project rather than permanently deleting it, preserving historical data while making it inactive.

tool_signatures.name: delete_project_task_assignment
tool_signatures.description: Remove a task assignment from a project, making the task unavailable for time tracking on that project.

tool_signatures.name: delete_task
tool_signatures.description: Delete (archive) a task. This action archives the task rather than permanently deleting it, preserving historical data while making it inactive.

tool_signatures.name: delete_time_entry
tool_signatures.description: Delete a time entry permanently. This action cannot be undone.

tool_signatures.name: delete_user
tool_signatures.description: Delete (archive) a user. This action archives the user rather than permanently deleting them, preserving time tracking history.

tool_signatures.name: get_client
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a specific client by its ID. Returns complete client details including contact information and billing configuration.

tool_signatures.name: get_company
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve company information and settings for the authenticated account. Returns comprehensive company details including billing configuration, time tracking preferences, and enabled features.

tool_signatures.name: get_current_user
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated user\

tool_signatures.name: get_estimate
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a specific estimate by ID with complete details including line items, terms, and client information.

tool_signatures.name: get_expense
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a specific expense by ID with complete details including receipts and billing information.

tool_signatures.name: get_expense_report
tool_signatures.description: Generate comprehensive expense reports with filtering by date range, users, clients, projects, and categories. Supports grouping and billing status filtering.

tool_signatures.name: get_invoice
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a specific invoice by ID with complete details including line items, payments, and billing information.

tool_signatures.name: get_project
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a specific project by its ID. Returns complete project details including client information, budget settings, billing configuration, and project dates.

tool_signatures.name: get_project_budget_report
tool_signatures.description: Generate project budget reports showing spending vs budgets across projects. Helps track project profitability and budget utilization.

tool_signatures.name: get_task
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a specific task by its ID. Returns complete task details including default billing settings and activity status.

tool_signatures.name: get_time_entry
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a specific time entry by its ID. Returns complete time entry details including project, task, user, and timing information.

tool_signatures.name: get_time_report
tool_signatures.description: Generate comprehensive time tracking reports with filtering by date range, users, clients, projects, and tasks. Supports grouping and billable status filtering.

tool_signatures.name: get_uninvoiced_report
tool_signatures.description: Generate reports of uninvoiced time and expenses within a date range. Essential for identifying billable work that hasn\

tool_signatures.name: get_user
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a specific user by ID. Returns complete user profile including roles, permissions, and billing rates.

tool_signatures.name: list_clients
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a list of clients with optional filtering by active status and updated date. Returns paginated results with client details including billing information.

tool_signatures.name: list_estimates
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve estimates with filtering by client, state, and date ranges. Returns paginated results with estimate details.

tool_signatures.name: list_expense_categories
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve available expense categories for expense classification and organization.

tool_signatures.name: list_expenses
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve expenses with filtering by user, client, project, billing status, and date ranges. Returns paginated results with expense details.

tool_signatures.name: list_invoices
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve invoices with optional filtering by client, project, state, and date ranges. Returns paginated results with complete invoice details.

tool_signatures.name: list_project_task_assignments
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve task assignments for a specific project. Shows which tasks are available for time tracking on the project and their specific settings.

tool_signatures.name: list_projects
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a list of projects with optional filtering by client, active status, and updated date. Returns paginated results with comprehensive project details.

tool_signatures.name: list_tasks
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a list of tasks with optional filtering. Tasks are the building blocks for time tracking and can be assigned to projects.

tool_signatures.name: list_time_entries
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a list of time entries with optional filtering. Supports filtering by user, client, project, task, billing status, date ranges, and more. Returns paginated results.

tool_signatures.name: list_users
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a list of users with optional filtering by active status and updated date. Returns paginated results with user profiles and permissions.

tool_signatures.name: restart_timer
tool_signatures.description: Restart a previously stopped timer, creating a new running time entry based on an existing entry.

tool_signatures.name: start_timer
tool_signatures.description: Start a timer for a new time entry. Creates a running time entry that tracks time automatically.

tool_signatures.name: stop_timer
tool_signatures.description: Stop a running timer and finalize the time entry with calculated hours.

tool_signatures.name: update_client
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing client. Can modify name, active status, address, and currency. Only provided fields will be updated.

tool_signatures.name: update_estimate
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing estimate including subject, terms, taxes, and other details. Only provided fields will be updated.

tool_signatures.name: update_expense
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing expense including project, category, cost, and billing details. Only provided fields will be updated.

tool_signatures.name: update_invoice
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing invoice including subject, dates, terms, taxes, and other billing details. Only provided fields will be updated.

tool_signatures.name: update_project
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing project. Can modify any project settings including name, billing configuration, budget settings, and project timeline. Only provided fields will be updated.

tool_signatures.name: update_project_task_assignment
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing project task assignment including rates, budget, and active status. Only provided fields will be updated.

tool_signatures.name: update_task
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing task. Can modify task name, billing settings, and activity status. Only provided fields will be updated.

tool_signatures.name: update_time_entry
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing time entry. Can modify project, task, hours, notes, and other fields. Only provided fields will be updated.

tool_signatures.name: update_user
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing user\
